answer_1.quote: Given an input text, generate a label followed by a rationale. ... We collect three types of rationale‑label pairs by applying the three task models on the test set of each dataset.
answer_1.outputs: free-text rationales (explanations) generated for a given label

answer_2.quote: We compare with two existing automatic metrics for free-text rationale evaluation: LAS and RQ. ... We propose a new metric REV, for Rationale Evaluation with conditional V-information.

answer_4.quote: We collect crowdworker judgments via Amazon Mechanical Turk to understand how REV correlates with human judgments of rationales.
answer_4.guideline: Workers were shown a question (input), an answer (label) and an explanation (rationale) and asked whether the explanation justifies the answer (yes/no). If yes, they rated the amount of additional information on a 4‑point Likert scale.
